AccessSessionMeta.description: Non-secret session metadata OpenVPN exposes to the hook (env vars).

description: Sent by the `openvpn-auth` helper to planner, and by planner to manager (nodeId added from identity).

nodeId.description: Filled by planner from its machine identity; helpers' values are ignored.

reauth.description:
Renegotiation of a session OpenVPN already verified with its HMAC auth token (`auth-gen-token
external-auth`): no password; the manager re-checks the account, groups, policy and session lifetime.

title: AccessAuthRequest
